facts.value: The University Computer Center (HRZ) provides students with the IT resources necessary for their studies (Goethe Card, HRZ account, student email address, etc.). It also offers advice and support for technical problems.
The university hotline assists with inquiries regarding applications, semester dates, registrations, subject changes, double studies, leave of absence, and exmatriculation.

International Student Services provides international students with information on topics such as residence permits, German courses, financing, successful studying, careers, and more. They also offer counseling and support.

The Student Services organization supports students in social and economic matters. It aims to ensure that students have the necessary infrastructure for successful studying in areas such as educational funding, student housing, dining halls, cafeterias, and advisory services.
